data.driver: ANGLE (NVIDIA, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Ti SUPER (0x00002689) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)

material.chromophores: Official BioSkin spectral decoder offline LUT; fixed 2D slice, not medical concentrations
material.pores: seeded subset and dimensions of retained area-sampled surface candidates

procedural.coordinateMethod: one continuous native csRest minus native head-frame translation; no zero body fRest
procedural.thicknessSource: native R05 geometry millimetres / path confidence
procedural.transmissionVisibility: native R06 pinna-exit and head-occlusion field

dermal.surfacePores: retained surface candidates plus original cellular microrelief, bounded micrometre relief and pixel-footprint filtering
dermal.vessels: soft procedural intradermal colour absorption on temples and upper cheeks; stable rest-space curves
dermal.scattering: RGB angular approximation plus retained diffuse-only face diffusion; no volume path tracing
